mid.name: Dispel Magic
mid.annotation: Too many debuffs in this game to not buy this item | If you get slowing hex > knockdown you die so always buy this item

mid.annotation: In conjuction with bat (2), and this item you should never touch the ground

mid.name: Tankbuster
mid.annotation: huge burst of damage can skip till later if the enemy team is not super tanky at this point. Never really a bad buy at any point in the game because it is % health.

late.name: Spirit Burn
late.annotation: You can legit rush this item and it will probably always be good | Main anti heal in this build.

late.name: Ethereal Shift

late.name: Spiritual Overflow
late.annotation: Not as good as it used to be since duration changes but still a nice spike

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Lots of cd's in this build that you want this for. mostly a slot locked buy, but it is eventually a must buy...
